introduction: Virginia weatherization provides approved home energy improvements through local nonprofit providers. It does not pay utility bills.
description: Virginia weatherization provides approved home energy improvements through local nonprofit providers. It does not pay utility bills.

sections.who: The provider reviews current income eligibility and property conditions. Contact the provider serving the home’s location for the actual assessment.
sections.get: Work can include air sealing, insulation, ventilation and heating or cooling improvements. The assessment determines suitable measures.
sections.docs:
• Household and income information.
  • Property and tenancy details.
  • Owner permission and records the local provider requests.
sections.apply:
1. Find intake

    Use Find Your Local Provider on DHCD Weatherization.

  2. Ask for the checklist

    Confirm eligibility evidence and permission requirements.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss access, safety and the proposed work plan.
sections.after: Weatherization is not intended as emergency no-heat response. Ask about separate energy assistance for an urgent heating problem.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DHCD weatherization; State WAP FAQ. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Will it pay an overdue bill?
No. DHCD says WAP does not pay utility bills.
The local provider where the home is located.
Only approved energy and safety work is covered.
Is it immediate furnace emergency service?
The state FAQ says it is not intended as emergency no-heat response.
